text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy!! It's Zenno Rob Roy!!
Zenno Rob Roy crosses the finish line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooooooahhh—!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious, Zenno Rob Roy!?
To actually beat the super strong
Symboli Kris S right here, right now...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haah...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I won.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really won...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A roar of victory echoes toward the heavens.
Vast, fierce, and boundless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy pulled it off.
She won the Arima Kinen. And—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...I don't know.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Did I manage to become someone meaningful to her?
I gave it everything I had.
I won, but... I still don't know.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I don't know... and I'm a little scared to find out—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um,
...we need to get ready for the concert, don't we?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you for your hard work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grab...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Looking over, ...my arm was being grabbed.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(No, it could hardly be called grabbing.
Because the strength in that hand was so terribly weak,
almost... almost like a baby's.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Rob Roy.
――Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Kris S-san's eyes waver.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Faintly. Yet undeniably, ――it sways.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Are you searching for words?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Are you searching... thinking about me?
...About who I am?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I'd be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If that were true, I'd be... so very happy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Honestly, I don't know if I ever managed to become a lingering regret to them.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even a while after the 'Arima Kinen' ended,
Kris S-san didn't retract her retirement.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, no matter what,
it's already over.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Our first and last Arima Kinen...
has now come to an end.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after the Arima Kinen, Zenno Rob Roy properly showed up for our meeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes looked just a tiny bit swollen from crying,
but... I decided not to point it out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
For the next goal... would the Tenno Sho (Spring) be okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for it. The glorious Spring Shield.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to make a name for myself, even more.
...I want to become a hero that everyone acknowledges.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What if... what if.
What if that person were to return—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
On as grand a stage as possible.
I want to welcome you as my finest self, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. Let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring) next.
...Yeah. Let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring) next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy doesn't stop walking.
She simply carries one more precious thing on her shoulders
as she continues forward.
